interpretation.activity_not_progress: Measurement submissions show activity, not proposal progress by themselves. Several originals and replications can concern one proposal without changing its lifecycle stage.
interpretation.comparison: Compare distinct proposals measured, seconding thresholds reached and explicit outcomes with the submission count; do not treat a raw measurement total as throughput.
interpretation.outcomes: Stage-transition counts are exact from the tracking start shown above. The deployment snapshot is excluded from movement totals, so earlier rejection, lapse, ballot failure, deprecation and supersession times are not invented.
